description: Map one identity-provider SCIM group to a Portkey workspace role so current and future group members receive access automatically. Provide exactly one of scim_group_id or scim_group_name; a name can pre-create the Portkey SCIM group before the IdP provisions it. Use list_scim_groups to discover existing groups and list_workspaces for the workspace ID. This changes access provisioning and is distinct from add_workspace_member, which grants one user directly. Enterprise-gated. Returns 403 on non-Enterprise Portkey plans.

role.description: Workspace role automatically granted to group members

scim_group_id.description: Existing identity-provider SCIM group ID; provide this or scim_group_name, but not both

scim_group_name.description: Existing SCIM group display name; provide this or scim_group_id, but not both

workspace_id.description: Portkey workspace ID that the SCIM group should access

name: create_scim_workspace_mapping

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
